boundaries.contract: `unsafe extern "C" fn()` stored as `EngineCleanupCb` and registered by `engine_table_register(Some(engine_unregister_all_pkey_asn1_meths))` at two sites in this file. Sole invocation path is the withheld `engine_cleanup_int`; no call executes at this source identity. A NULL run-once lock would only make the callee a documented no-op/leak, pinned by the C8 probe.
